title: sdr daily scratchpad - 2026-03-20
content:
SDR Daily scratchpad — Fri 2026-03-20

Daily goals:
- 20 outbound calls (target: enterprise mid-market)
- 15 follow-up emails
- Book 2 discovery meetings / 1 product demo
- Update CRM notes + dispositions after each call

Time blocks (rough):
- 08:30-09:00: quick inbox triage + prioritize warm replies
- 09:00-10:30: Prospecting / first touch sequences (Cadence A)
- 10:30-12:00: Call block (follow-ups + voicemails)
- 12:00-13:00: Lunch / short break
- 13:00-15:00: Call block (Europe-friendly times)
- 15:00-16:00: Email follow-ups + LinkedIn touches
- 16:00-17:30: Wrap up CRM updates, handoffs to AEs, plan tomorrow

Priority accounts (today):
1) Acme Corp — IT Ops lead: Priya Sharma (VP Infra) — last touch: 2026-03-16 demo request; AE: Noah Wells — Objective: push for OK to run pilot + pricing CTAs — Notes: interested in Dedicated offering for isolation; potential $120k ARR; next: confirm compliance questions, set pilot scope.

2) Greenfield Health — Dir Eng: Mark Rivera — last touch: 2026-03-12 email (no response) — Objective: re-engage, suggest short proof-of-concept for embeddings search; Notes: HIPAA concerns flagged; loop in security (Sarah Kim).

3) Atlas Retail — Head of Data: Elena Zhou — last touch: 2026-03-18 voicemails x2 — Objective: secure 30-min intro; Notes: Mention Redwood Optimize to lower token cost; mid-market, ~ $30k ARR potential.

Call list (high priority first):
- 09:10 Acme Corp — Priya Sharma — voicemail left (left short benefit-focused message). NEXT: email w/ one-pager + pilot scope (send by 10:00).
- 09:30 Greenfield Health — Mark Rivera — reached voicemail, left message. NEXT: send HIPAA checklist + request availability for 30m.
- 10:00 Atlas Retail — Elena Zhou — connected briefly, said "send details". NEXT: email with Optimize sheet + pricing band.
- 10:30 Orion Logistics — Sam Patel (CTO) — busy, reschedule. NEXT: propose Tue/Thu morning.
- 11:15 Nimbus AI — Jonah Lee (Lead ML Eng) — demo booked for 2026-03-25. Confirm pre-demo materials.

Follow-ups (timed):
- Send Acme pilot scope + security contacts by 10:00 (template below).
- Follow up Greenfield with HIPAA doc by 11:00.
- Post-call: update CRM + tag "pilot-interest" / assign Noah.

Email templates (short — personalize 1-2 lines):
- Pilot intro (for Acme):
Subject: Pilot scope + next steps — Redwood + Acme
Hi Priya,
Thanks for the quick chat. Attached is a 1‑page pilot scope (steps, timeline, success metrics). If this looks good I can coordinate a short kickoff with our security lead (Sarah Kim) and set up access for a 4-week pilot. Does Wed or Thu next week work?
Best,
Julia Park

- Re-engage (Greenfield):
Subject: HIPAA + quick POC for embeddings search
Hi Mark,
Hope you're well — wanted to follow up on building a quick POC for embeddings-based search. Attached is our HIPAA checklist and a 30‑minute plan. If you’re open, I can set up a short call this week to walk through details.
Thanks,
Julia

Dispositions / CRM quick codes (use after call):
- interested-pilot
- meet-booked
- not-interested
- left-voicemail
- no-response

Pipeline notes / forecast flags:
- Acme: motion = pilot -> potential expansion to Dedicated; Sales stage = POC; estimated ARR = 120000; AE = Noah Wells. Probability: 40% if security clears.
- Greenfield: gated by compliance; need security sign-off; estimated ARR = 50k.
- Atlas: early interest; price sensitivity.

Questions / To do (notes to self):
- Ask AE (Noah) to confirm whether Acme needs on-prem or VPC — impacts pricing and timeline.
- Pull latest security FAQ (Confluence) and attach to outreach.
- Update Jira JIRA-4521 with Acme pilot success criteria (remind Noah).

Random quick wins:
- Send LinkedIn connection to Elena after emailing (personalize with recent product update).
- Quick internal note to product: customers asking about token-level cost breakdown for cache behavior — flag to console team.

Resources / links used today:
- Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SDR/pages/CONFLUENCE-12345 (hipaa checklist + pilot templates)
- Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/JIRA-4521 (Acme pilot ticket)
- Slack: #sdr-team (ask about updated pricing bands)

End-of-day wrap (to fill later):
- Calls completed: __ / 20
- Meetings booked: __
- Emails sent: __
- CRM updates: __

Notes-to-self: keep outreach concise, always end with a single CTA (time or next deliverable).
